title: sube
description: Supply-use based econometric workflow tools — building domestic matrices, Leontief-style SUBE multipliers, and elasticity regressions for reproducible input-output analysis.

title: gg2d3
description: Renders ggplot2 objects with D3 via htmlwidgets.

title: bsvarPost
description: Post-estimation tools for Bayesian structural vector autoregressions fitted with 'bsvars' and 'bsvarSIGNs' — impulse responses, dynamic multipliers, decompositions, and model comparison.

title: typstR
description: Publication-ready scientific documents with Quarto and Typst — manuscript scaffolding and reusable templates for working papers, articles, and policy briefs.

title: vizRd
description: Data-agnostic instant dashboards — launch a Shiny dashboard from a project folder without editing code.

title: esrnn
description: A 'torch' implementation of the ES-RNN hybrid model (winning entry of the M4 Forecasting Competition) for short-horizon time series forecasting and nowcasting.

title: wiiwcast
description: High-frequency nowcasting of monthly CESEE foreign trade, reading from a partitioned parquet mirror of the Haver Analytics DLX database via DuckDB.

title: fidelio
description: R-first reconstruction of the FIDELIO multi-country input-output model, with FIGARO-shaped inputs and transparent matrix assembly.
